job: One hub call per discovery item of a product project (bin/discovery-daily.sh <project> via dd_item in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh, once a day): it answers four narrow questions and writes a draft ticket as one JSON object. A rules table in code (bin/lib/discovery/rules.sh) decides ticket, comment or noise.

composition.purpose: the answer rules and the STE and De-AI voice rules
the narrow factual questions the rules table reads

composition.source: the source adapter's list line (bin/lib/discovery/<source>.sh dd_src_<source>_list)
composition.cap: one JSON line: id, title, url, counts, first and last seen
composition.purpose: THE SCOPED DELTA: which item this call is about

composition.cap: message 4000 chars, the last 30 frames per exception, 12000 bytes in the prompt
composition.purpose: the stack trace and tags of the one item

composition.source: open issues of the target repo whose title or body holds the first 60 chars of the item title

bounds: [lane:no_tools] the call runs with AGENT_CALL_NO_TOOLS=1, so the session cannot read files or the web and grow past its prompt (VERIFIED: tests/discovery-daily.bh-9795-test.sh D8)
[lane:detail_cut] the item detail is cut to 12000 bytes in the prompt by dd_prompt in bin/lib/discovery-daily.sh (VERIFIED: tests/discovery-daily.bh-9795-test.sh D8)
[lane:candidates] at most 5 candidate tickets of 600 body bytes each by st_candidates (VERIFIED: tests/sentry-triage.bh-5620-test.sh T14)
[lane:calls_day] at most DISCOVERY_MAX_CALLS_DAY calls per project per day, counted before each call (VERIFIED: tests/discovery-daily.bh-9795-test.sh D6)
